note: The western coastal region of a country or continent; capitalization depends on whether it names a recognized region.

senses.m: The western coastal region of a country or continent
senses.pat: the West Coast of · travel along the west coast · West Coast cities
ex: They drove along the West Coast of the United States.
Họ lái xe dọc Bờ Tây Hoa Kỳ.
Storms are forecast along the west coast tonight.
Dự báo có bão dọc bờ biển phía tây tối nay.

note: A person who discourages other people’s enthusiasm; informal and critical.

senses.m: A person who discourages other people’s enthusiasm
senses.pat: be a wet blanket · call someone a wet blanket · a wet-blanket attitude
ex: Don’t be a wet blanket; come celebrate with us.
Đừng làm mất hứng; đến ăn mừng cùng chúng tôi đi.
His wet-blanket response ended the discussion.
Phản ứng làm cụt hứng của anh chấm dứt cuộc thảo luận.

note: A flag used to signal surrender or a request for a truce; figuratively, an admission of defeat.

senses.m: A flag used to signal surrender or a request for a truce
senses.pat: raise/wave a white flag · surrender under a white flag · refuse to wave the white flag
ex: The troops raised a white flag to request a truce.
Quân lính giương cờ trắng để xin đình chiến.
The team refused to wave the white flag despite the setback.
Đội không chịu đầu hàng dù gặp trở ngại.

note: A person who rescues someone or something from difficulty; in business, a friendly buyer who helps a company resist a hostile takeover.

senses.m: A person who rescues someone or something from difficulty
senses.pat: a white knight investor · come to someone’s rescue · act as a white knight
ex: A white knight investor offered to save the company.
Một nhà đầu tư “hiệp sĩ trắng” đề nghị cứu công ty.
She became a white knight for the struggling arts center.
Cô trở thành người giải cứu trung tâm nghệ thuật đang gặp khó khăn.

note: A pointless or hopeless search; an idiom, often preceded by go on or send someone on.

senses.pat: go on a wild goose chase · send someone on a wild goose chase · a fruitless chase
ex: The outdated address sent us on a wild goose chase.
Địa chỉ cũ khiến chúng tôi tìm kiếm vô ích.
They spent hours on a wild goose chase for the missing file.
Họ mất hàng giờ tìm kiếm vô vọng tệp bị thất lạc.

note: A restaurant employee who serves or advises on wine; in some establishments this role is a sommelier.

senses.m: A restaurant employee who serves or advises on wine
senses.pat: ask the wine waiter · a knowledgeable wine waiter · wine-waiter service
ex: The wine waiter recommended a local red wine.
Nhân viên phục vụ rượu vang gợi ý một loại vang đỏ địa phương.
We asked the wine waiter to suggest a bottle for dinner.
Chúng tôi nhờ nhân viên rượu vang gợi ý một chai cho bữa tối.

note: An upholstered armchair with high sides or “wings” beside the head; also wingback chair.

senses.m: An upholstered armchair with high sides or “wings” beside the head
senses.pat: sit in a wing chair · a leather wing chair · wing-chair upholstery
ex: He read by the fireplace in a wing chair.
Ông đọc sách bên lò sưởi trên chiếc ghế bành có cánh.
The antique wing chair was reupholstered.
Chiếc ghế bành cổ được bọc lại.

note: A senior officer rank in some air forces, including the Royal Air Force; equivalent levels differ between countries.

senses.m: A senior officer rank in some air forces, including the Royal Air Force
senses.pat: a wing commander in the RAF · promote to wing commander · wing-commander rank
ex: The wing commander addressed the aircrew.
Trung tá không quân phát biểu với phi hành đoàn.
She served as a wing commander in the air force.
Bà phục vụ với cấp bậc wing commander trong không quân.

note: The finish line in a horse race; historically a post marking the end of the course.

senses.m: The finish line in a horse race
senses.pat: reach/pass the winning post · first past the winning post · winning-post line
ex: The horse crossed the winning post ahead of the field.
Con ngựa vượt qua vạch đích trước các đối thủ.
The race was decided just before the winning post.
Cuộc đua được phân định ngay trước vạch đích.

note: A news organization that supplies reports to subscribing media outlets; also news agency or newswire.

senses.m: A news organization that supplies reports to subscribing media outlets
senses.pat: a wire service report · subscribe to a wire service · wire-service correspondent
ex: The newspaper used a wire-service report for the breaking story.
Tờ báo dùng tin từ hãng thông tấn cho sự kiện vừa xảy ra.
A wire service distributed the photograph to media outlets.
Một hãng thông tấn phân phối bức ảnh cho các cơ quan truyền thông.

note: One of the four rearmost molars, which often appears in late adolescence or early adulthood; not everyone develops all four.

senses.m: One of the four rearmost molars, which often appears in late adolescence or early adulthood
senses.pat: a wisdom tooth erupts · remove a wisdom tooth · impacted wisdom tooth
ex: Her wisdom tooth was removed by a dentist.
Răng khôn của cô được nha sĩ nhổ.
An impacted wisdom tooth can cause pain or infection.
Răng khôn mọc ngầm có thể gây đau hoặc nhiễm trùng.

note: A person who acts as if they know everything, often in an irritating or sarcastic way; US informal. Also a euphemistic term for a gangster.

senses.m: A person who acts as if they know everything, often in an irritating or sarcastic way
senses.pat: don’t be a wise guy · a sarcastic wise guy · wise-guy remark
ex: Don’t be a wise guy; just answer the question.
Đừng có tỏ vẻ ta đây; trả lời câu hỏi đi.
The film uses wise guy as slang for a mobster.
Bộ phim dùng wise guy như tiếng lóng chỉ thành viên băng đảng.

note: A traditional healer or spiritual practitioner in some societies; the term is often considered colonial, inaccurate, or derogatory. Use a community’s own title when known.

senses.m: A traditional healer or spiritual practitioner in some societies
senses.pat: consult a traditional healer · the term witch doctor · a healer in the community
ex: The article avoids the outdated label witch doctor and uses the healer’s local title.
Bài báo tránh nhãn gọi lỗi thời witch doctor và dùng danh xưng địa phương của người chữa bệnh.
Researchers consulted a traditional healer with the community’s consent.
Các nhà nghiên cứu tham vấn người chữa bệnh truyền thống với sự đồng thuận của cộng đồng.

note: A basket holding sewing, knitting, or other household work in progress; old-fashioned.

senses.m: A basket holding sewing, knitting, or other household work in progress
senses.pat: a sewing work basket · keep yarn in a work basket · work-basket contents
ex: Her work basket held needles, thread, and fabric.
Giỏ đồ khâu vá của bà có kim, chỉ và vải.
She kept the knitting in a work basket beside her chair.
Bà để đồ đan trong giỏ cạnh ghế.

note: An international organization that administers trade agreements and provides a forum for negotiations and dispute settlement; abbreviated WTO.

senses.m: An international organization that administers trade agreements and provides a forum for negotiations and dispute settlement
senses.pat: the World Trade Organization (WTO) · WTO member · bring a dispute to the WTO
ex: The World Trade Organization published its annual trade report.
Tổ chức Thương mại Thế giới công bố báo cáo thương mại thường niên.
The country joined the WTO after years of negotiations.
Quốc gia gia nhập WTO sau nhiều năm đàm phán.

note: Damaged or exhausted through long use; also extremely tired.

senses.m: Damaged or exhausted through long use
senses.pat: a worn-out pair of shoes · feel worn out · wear something out
ex: The hikers felt worn out after the long climb.
Những người đi bộ cảm thấy kiệt sức sau chặng leo dài.
He replaced the worn-out brake pads.
Anh thay má phanh đã mòn.

note: A sale of used household goods held outside or at a home, especially in North America; also garage sale.

senses.m: A sale of used household goods held outside or at a home, especially in North America
senses.pat: hold a yard sale · find something at a yard sale · yard-sale bargain
ex: They held a yard sale to clear out the garage.
Họ tổ chức bán đồ cũ trước sân để dọn nhà để xe.
I found a desk for five dollars at a yard sale.
Tôi tìm được chiếc bàn giá năm đô la ở buổi bán đồ cũ.

note: A mosquito-borne viral disease that can cause fever, jaundice, and severe illness; vaccination and travel guidance depend on destination and current public-health advice.

senses.m: A mosquito-borne viral disease that can cause fever, jaundice, and severe illness
senses.pat: yellow-fever vaccine · yellow-fever outbreak · risk of yellow fever
ex: Travelers checked vaccination requirements for yellow fever.
Du khách kiểm tra yêu cầu tiêm phòng sốt vàng da.
The public-health team monitored a yellow-fever outbreak.
Đội y tế công cộng theo dõi đợt bùng phát sốt vàng da.
